social_circle.name: Maya Nguyen

demographics.occupation: Pre-nursing student at the University of Washington (rising sophomore)
demographics.location: Seattle, WA (U-District, lives in a shared apartment near UW)
demographics.education: Graduated Ellensburg High School in 2025; currently in BSN program at the University of Washington School of Nursing

background.how_they_met: Met in fifth grade at an Ellensburg public elementary school and were inseparable through middle and high school. Maya was a fixture at the Le household — she came over Sunday mornings to make dumplings with Qiao and Wei, slept over weekly, and was the friend Qiao called when she decided to reject the pre-nursing path.
background.why_close: Sister-adjacent intimacy built across childhood: shared bicultural-kid-in-mostly-white-Ellensburg experience (Maya is Vietnamese-American, Qiao Chinese-American), mutual family integration (Maya knows Nai Nai, Wei treats her as a third daughter), and a track record of being each other's emotional first-responder through the Tyler breakup and Maya's nursing-school stress.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: High-volume texter — fires off short rapid-fire messages, lowercase, heavy use of 'bestie', 'literally', and crying-laughing emoji. Sends voice notes after long shifts. Always responds within minutes even during clinicals. Comfortable saying hard things directly ('go to therapy', 'don't text him back').

shared_activities: Monthly Seattle weekends — Qiao drives over Snoqualmie Pass, crashes at Maya's apartment, photo walks around Pike Place and Capitol Hill
Sunday dumpling sessions at the Le house when Maya is home in Ellensburg
K-drama co-watch over FaceTime
Joint Mitski-stan threads and concert planning
Mutual venting about parental expectations and Asian-American family stuff
social_circle.communication_frequency: Multiple times daily (texts + voice notes; near-constant async stream)
recent_text_topics: UW transfer portal anxiety — Maya is the one Qiao texts every time she refreshes the portal, with Maya talking her off the ledge and reminding her August is still months away.
Mitski in Vancouver October 2026 — they are debating whether to split a hotel with Kevin, whether Maya can get the weekend off clinicals, and how to afford the resale tickets.
Maya's first med-surg rotation horror stories at Harborview, which double as warnings to Qiao about why she was right not to do nursing.
A running thread about Tyler-sightings on WSU Instagram (Maya screenshots and sends them with 'do not engage'), tied to Qiao's anxiety-replay tendency.
Olympic National Park trip recap photos — Maya is mad she wasn't invited and is lobbying for a Maya-Qiao-only North Cascades trip in August before UW starts.

social_circle.name: Wei Le (mom)

demographics.occupation: Registered Nurse, med-surg floor at Kittitas Valley Healthcare (12-hour shifts, ~$85K/yr)
demographics.location: Ellensburg, WA (same house as Qiao, off Manitoba Avenue)
demographics.education: BSN from a university in Hangzhou, China; re-credentialed in the U.S.

background.how_they_met: Mother-daughter — Wei emigrated from Hangzhou before Qiao was born and gave birth to her in Ellensburg in February 2008. They met at the Chinese student association at CWU with Qiao's dad.
background.why_close: Wei is Qiao's primary attachment figure and household co-runner. Despite the January 2025 nursing-vs-communications fight, they reconciled and now share daily logistics: Wei's shift schedule, Nai Nai's medication times, dumpling Sundays, FaceTime calls with the Hangzhou grandparents, and a mutual worry-loop about Wei's father's worsening dementia.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in a mix of English and Mandarin pinyin (with the occasional Chinese character when on her own phone). Uses periods. Sends grocery-list bullet points and one-word follow-ups ('ok', 'received', '记得 dishwasher'). Calls more than she texts when something is important. Strong emoji game for someone her age — heart, peach, and the praying-hands emoji especially.

shared_activities: Sunday dumpling-making (now without Maya present most weeks)
Sunday 7 PM FaceTime with grandparents in Hangzhou — Wei enforces Mandarin-only
Joint Nai Nai medication-reminder system
Driving Andy to orthodontist (Qiao executes, Wei coordinates)
Family group chat that Qiao manages but Wei drives content into
social_circle.communication_frequency: Daily (multiple short texts even when both home; spikes during Wei's 12-hour shifts)
recent_text_topics: Nai Nai's blood-pressure and blood-thinner schedule — Wei texts from work to confirm Qiao gave the 8 PM dose, especially on long-shift days.
Wei's possible three-week November 2026 trip to Hangzhou to see her father (dementia worsening) — they are quietly negotiating who covers Nai Nai's care and Andy's orthodontist runs if she goes.
UW transfer worry — Wei texts every couple of days asking if the portal updated, framed as 'just checking', with a peach emoji.
Grocery runs to the Asian market in Yakima (Qiao volunteers to drive when she's headed that way for friends).
Soft, ongoing nursing-school 'jokes' — Wei still drops 'you know, you could still go back' once a month, which is now a running mom-bit rather than pressure.

She's connected to the schools through her nursing work'; Q35: 'my mom is really stressed about that — she's been trying to figure out if she should go back for a longer visit'; Q44: 'My mom noticed and made me my favorite — beef noodle soup — without asking'; Q46: 'My mom is anxious chronically ... Multicultural student group volunteering at CWU
Joint TikTok-dunking sessions on bad takes
Internship-application support — they swap cover letters and commiserate over rejections
